evals.name: create-two-domains-with-dep
evals.prompt: emberdeck 덱에 결제 도메인이랑 알림 도메인 두 개 잡아줘. 결제가 결제 완료될 때 알림 도메인을 호출해서 알림을 보내는 구조야. 아직 카드가 하나도 없는 빈 덱이야.
evals.expected_output: Two domain cards created (payment-ish, notification-ish), each with non-empty overview and an IN/OUT scope. The payment domain carries cross_domain_dependencies pointing at the notification domain with relationship exactly 'invokes' (free text only in note). Since neither domain has brief children yet, cards stay draft (active would trip empty-tree). `ed validate cards` total 0.

evals.name: fix-free-text-relationship
evals.prompt: ed validate cards 돌렸더니 billing 카드에서 relationship-free-text 가 나와. 뭐가 문제인지 보고 제대로 고쳐줘.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes relationship must be the enum invokes|consumes; rewrites the dep as relationship='consumes' (matching '이벤트를 구독한다') with the original prose moved to note. In-place update via read-modify-write (whole domain namespace resent, overview/scope preserved). validate clean afterward.

evals.name: update-scope-only
evals.prompt: payment 도메인의 scope에 '구독 결제(빌링키 관리)'도 IN으로 추가해줘. overview랑 cross_domain_dependencies는 절대 건드리지 마.
evals.expected_output: scope gains the subscription-billing IN item; overview byte-for-byte preserved; cross_domain_dependencies preserved exactly (patch must resend them — omitting the optional array would silently drop it). validate clean.

evals.name: activate-empty-domain-trap
evals.prompt: payment 도메인 이제 내용 확정됐으니까 active로 올려줘.
evals.expected_output: Knows an active domain with no child cards is flagged empty-tree by validate (findings gate, exit != 0). Does not leave the deck failing: either keeps/returns the domain to draft and explains it needs its first brief child before activation, or activates it together with a legitimate first brief. Final `ed validate cards` total 0, and the child requirement is explained.
